changelog: Share any content as clean readable web links. Supports markdown and plain text with auto-structuring. Includes refactor-and-share prompt for AI-powered formatting.
summary: Share markdown files and text as clean, readable web links via plsreadme.com. Use when someone asks to share a document, README, PRD, proposal, notes, or any markdown as a shareable link. Also triggers for "create a preview link", "share this as a page", or "make this readable". Requires the plsreadme MCP server (npx plsreadme-mcp).
